data.body:
S4 landed via Gerrit change 1991, merged as df1d8202a6f2d0063677144cb09de28cb54f2d08 (LLM-Review+1 clean PASS + Verified+1, CI run 32471109341). AC-to-evidence:

AC1 (every capability validates against one declared extra + one typed posture, no probe import): src/rebar/_capabilities.py holds the 14-record stdlib-only registry (agent_runtime/audit_ui/bedrock_provider/jira_datacenter/s3_remote=error, metrics_lizard/pricing=unavailable, grounding_structural/grounding_t2=abstain, cloud_adf/datacenter_wiki/trace_export=fallback, mcp_server/review_bot=error). validate() is pure/structural (undeclared_extra, invalid_posture, duplicate_key, empty_probe) and returns () for the shipped registry; availability uses importlib.util.find_spec only. Proof: tests/unit/test_capabilities.py — test_shipped_registry_validates_clean, test_each_capability_has_expected_extra_and_posture, test_registry_never_imports_a_probe_package (sys.modules delta over a full is_available sweep), test_every_capability_extra_is_a_declared_packaging_extra + test_declared_extras_constant_matches_pyproject (pyproject parity, dev excluded).

AC2 (stable commands + top-level help present in no-extras wheel; only the selected boundary emits an actionable error for error postures): _cli/_registry.py single-sources KNOWN_CAPABILITIES from the registry (descriptive validation, no enforcement at route/help construction; import-isolation preserved — the CI clean-core-wheel + optional-extras-isolate gates passed). The shared error helper require_capability/missing_error raises OptionalDependencyError only at the selected boundary. Proof: test_capabilities.py require_capability tests + _optional delegator test; existing test_audit_serve_heldout (nava-rebar[ui] at serve, not show).

AC3 (lean read/dry-run modes run without sibling live capabilities incl. audit show and non-agent review/workflow): boundaries invoke the guard only after mode/backend selection — audit serve (audit_ui), Bedrock provider construction (bedrock_provider), Jira DC client (jira_datacenter). Proof: test_audit_serve_heldout (show works lean), tests/interfaces/store/test_llm_optionality.py (lean diagnostics vs live agent).

AC4 (metrics/pricing unavailable, grounding abstain, adf/wiki/tracing fallback, selected provider errors retain existing domain/exception/stream/exit contracts): domain components unchanged — the registry never manufactures their result. Proof: test_lizard_complexity_heldout, grounding/test_non_adoption, rich_text_seam_heldout, wiki_render_hardening, test_bedrock_provider, jira_dc_transport_heldout all GREEN.

AC5 (rebar-mcp and review-bot remain separate entry points, consume capability metadata, absent from top-level route registry): mcp_server/review_bot are registry capabilities but not CLI routes. Proof: test_capabilities.py test_mcp_and_reviewbot_are_capabilities_but_not_cli_routes; tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp.py + test_reviewbot_bedrock_cutover GREEN.

Held-out TDD: happy-path stayed in tree; edge/E2E (validation, shared error helper exact strings, import-isolation, pyproject parity, single-source route validation, mcp/reviewbot-not-a-route) were held out of the implementer's tree, then restored — 24 tests GREEN; teeth confirmed (install-hint + posture mutations each tripped a held-out test). Local make lint/typecheck, complexity ratchet (new=0/increased=0), and module-size gate all clean.
